table.name: Cartoon
table.purpose: Episode list for an animated TV series (evidently 'Batman: The Brave and the Bold', given the episode titles, directors, and 2008–2009 air dates). Each row is one episode with its title, production code, credits, air date, and the channel it aired on.

Channel.name: channel_id
Channel.description: Identifier of the TV channel the episode aired on; references TV_Channel.id (e.g. 701, 704, 707 are music-content channels). Stored as text but numeric in the 700s.

Directed_by.name: directed_by
Directed_by.description: Name of the episode's director (Ben Jones, Brandon Vietti, or Michael Chang).

Original_air_date.name: original_air_date
Original_air_date.description: Date the episode first aired, e.g. 'December12,2008' (US format, month name + day + year, stored as text without spaces).

Production_code.name: production_code
Production_code.description: Episode production code, sequential integers 101–112 (season 1, episodes 1–12).

Title.name: title
Title.description: Title of the episode, e.g. 'Day of the Dark Knight!', 'Fall of the Blue Beetle!'.

Written_by.name: written_by
Written_by.description: Name of the episode's writer(s), e.g. 'J. M. DeMatteis', 'Steven Melching'.

id.name: episode_id
id.description: Primary key; sequential episode identifier 1–12. The TV_series table's Share, Rating, and Viewers_m columns appear to reference it (likely per-episode ratings/viewership data), though the exact semantics of that link are not fully evidenced.

table.name: TV_Channel
table.purpose: A catalog of music TV channels (mostly Italian Sky/MTV music channels), each row describing one channel: its name, country, language, content genre, broadcast technical parameters, and subscription package. Referenced by TV_series and Cartoon via Channel id, so it serves as the channel dimension for TV series and cartoons broadcast on these channels.

Content.name: Content
Content.description: Genre of the channel's content. All rows are 'music', so this catalog holds only music channels.

Country.name: Country
Country.description: Country of origin/broadcast of the channel (Italy, United Kingdom, Poland).

Hight_definition_TV.name: High_definition_TV
Hight_definition_TV.description: Whether the channel broadcasts in high definition ('yes'/'no'). Column name is misspelled ('Hight').

Language.name: Language
Language.description: Primary broadcast language of the channel (Italian or English).

Package_Option.name: Package_Option
Package_Option.description: Subscription package the channel belongs to (e.g. 'Sky Famiglia', 'Sky Famiglia + Sky HD') or 'no ( FTV )' meaning free-to-view, i.e. not part of a pay package.

Pay_per_view_PPV.name: Pay_per_view_PPV
Pay_per_view_PPV.description: Whether the channel is pay-per-view ('yes'/'no'). All rows are 'no'.

Pixel_aspect_ratio_PAR.name: Pixel_aspect_ratio_PAR
Pixel_aspect_ratio_PAR.description: Pixel aspect ratio of the broadcast video signal: 4:3, 16:9, or both ('4:3 / 16:9').

id.name: id
id.description: Primary key; channel identifier (numeric, 700-728). Referenced by TV_series.Channel and Cartoon.Channel.

series_name.name: series_name
series_name.description: Name of the TV channel (e.g. 'Sky Music', 'MTV Hits', 'Rock TV'). Despite the column name, values are channel names, not series names; unique per row.

table.name: TV_series
table.purpose: Episode-by-episode U.S. television ratings data for a 2007 TV series (episode titles such as 'Friendly Skies', 'Blowback', 'A Love of a Lifetime' match the NBC series Journeyman). Each row is one aired episode with its Nielsen ratings, viewership, and weekly rank.

18_49_Rating_Share.name: 18_49_Rating_Share
18_49_Rating_Share.description: Nielsen adults 18-49 demographic rating and share, written as 'rating/share' (e.g. '2.4/6' = 2.4% of the 18-49 demographic watching, 6% of those watching TV at that time).

Air_Date.name: Air_Date
Air_Date.description: Original U.S. broadcast date of the episode, stored as formatted text ('Month Day, Year'); all values fall in October-December 2007, a weekly air schedule.

Channel.name: Channel
Channel.description: Identifier of the TV channel/network the episode aired on; references TV_Channel.id. Note: the lookup shows these IDs labeled as 'music' content, which conflicts with a scripted drama series, so the exact channel identity is uncertain even though the join is valid.

Episode.name: Episode
Episode.description: Title of the episode; unique per row, matching episode titles of the 2007 series Journeyman.

Rating.name: Rating
Rating.description: Overall Nielsen household rating (percentage of households watching), ranging 3.0-5.8. The detected join to Cartoon.id is spurious (coincidental numeric overlap) and should be ignored.

Share.name: Share
Share.description: Overall Nielsen share (percentage of households watching TV at that time that were watching this episode), 5-9. The detected join to Cartoon.id is spurious and should be ignored.

Viewers_m.name: Viewers_m
Viewers_m.description: Number of viewers in millions (4.24-9.16). The detected join to Cartoon.id is spurious and should be ignored.

Weekly_Rank.name: Weekly_Rank
Weekly_Rank.description: Rank of the episode's viewership among all network primetime programs for that week (43-80, lower is better).

id.name: id
id.description: Surrogate primary key, sequential 1-12, one per episode row.
